niche: a survey research firm's telephone centre deciding which of its recurring telephone projects run with the predictive dialer's answering machine detection switched off in 2027, judged on each project's share of the calls the dialer classed as answering machines that a person had in fact answered, against the firm's one-in-ten limit

world.geography: United States, Minnesota (a fictional survey research firm in Saint Paul)
world.org_type: independent survey research firm running a telephone centre for public-agency, university and association clients

driver: A recorded classification's error rate is a property of the population classified, not of the classifier, so the rate certified on the maker's reference set and confirmed on the one population checked by hand does not carry to the others; each population's rate is recovered from a reaction that only misclassified members produce, scaled by the same reaction's rate among members known to be in the true class, counting only reactions quick enough to exclude the delayed ones the other class produces.
driver_concrete: Each project's share of machine-classed calls that a person answered is the share of those calls returned to the project's caller-ID line within minutes, divided by the share of the project's abandoned live calls returned within minutes: both groups heard the same recorded message as the dialer hung up, only a person returns a call that fast, and machine owners return calls hours later from voicemail; the detector's certified false-machine rate and the 2025 listening test on the pilot project hold only for populations that answer with a short greeting.
stump: A competent analyst takes the detector's certified false-machine rate (about 2 per cent on the maker's reference set, confirmed by the firm's 2025 listening test on its pilot project) as every project's rate, finds every project far under the one-in-ten limit and keeps answering machine detection on all of them in 2027; the step that lands it there is carrying a classifier's certified error rate to populations that answer the phone differently, when the projects calling older people, farms and businesses lose a seventh to a third of their machine-classed calls to people the dialer hung up on.
analyst_test: With every field and rule read correctly, the easy route carries the detector's certified false-machine rate (about 2 per cent, confirmed by the 2025 listening test on the pilot) to every project, puts all of them under the one-in-ten limit and keeps detection on everywhere; the golden switches it off on about six projects whose populations answer with long greetings (13 to 31 per cent), and counting every callback at any delay switches it off on all of them.
domain_test: General statistics, missing data and measurement error: the deciding quantity is a recorded classification's error rate per population (each project's share of machine-classed calls a person answered), estimated as the ratio of two conditional reaction rates on the same project (prompt callbacks after machine-classed hang-ups over prompt callbacks after abandoned live calls); replacing it with the classifier's certified rate, a generic summary, moves the call from no project to six, so the swap of the method changes the answer.

differentiation.task281: task281 reads a wear-out failure share past a lifetime record too young to show its plateau; task241 recovers a classifier error rate per population from prompt return calls scaled by the same reaction among abandoned live calls: no quantity, mechanism or file in common
differentiation.task454: task454 fills uncovered items cost from a price survey whose coverage differs by presentation; task241 has no coverage gap to fill and no cost: its share is a misclassification rate read from a reaction only misclassified people produce
differentiation.task468: task468 (v1) corrects a per-unit count for a record matcher that fails more for some units and a cluster review that sees them unevenly; task241 has no matcher and no review sample: the decisive share comes from return calls against abandoned calls on each project

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-01 at the re-check, on the honest survivor anatomy and not on a portal result (the shipped pack 8dca2562 stays at the portal, pending): the golden is the field's own delayed-mode salinity calibration (potential-temperature levels against reference water mapped to the float's position) applied as the textbook states it, so the field's method is the top rung rather than rung 0 or 1 (stumping 1.1b); the easy-route sort reproduces the golden six (they are exactly the top six by magnitude on the pooled temperature-level rung); Reflex, Back-test and Shock fail, Link holds only in part. The clean-truth easy routes (fixed pressure 15, nearest casts 13, pooled levels 12, drift 4) do file wrong sets.
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a sensor's own error read against an external reference whose value at a fixed position in the medium moves with a displacement of the medium that the reference years did not share and with a slow drift of the medium's properties across the area, so the error has to be read on a coordinate the displacement carries with it and against reference medium from the sensor's own place; read at fixed position against the area's average, the medium's shift and its gradient are taken for sensor error, and both false flags and misses follow.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst differences each float's good 2027 salinity values between 1,400 and 1,900 dbar against the reference casts' mean salinity at the same pressure and files 14 of the 24 floats adjusted, the six whose sensors are off and eight whose sensors read true; the step that lands it there is comparing at fixed pressure, when the deep layer sat deeper in 2027 than in the reference years and heaved with eddies and the salinity of water at a given temperature falls westward, so only the offset on potential-temperature levels against reference water at each profile's own position gives the six.
lineage.niche: a national ocean institute's delayed-mode quality control of its regional profiling-float array: which floats' 2027 salinity records the delayed-mode release adjusts, each float's conductivity-sensor offset read against ship reference casts in the deep water below the Mediterranean outflow
